title: Extension SKU never boundary-tested through the M-1 gate — all non-paid fixtures hardcode sku_type 'vacancy_unlock'
evidence:
build_event_body_full(
      event_id,
      "checkout.session.completed",
      session_id,
      vacancy_id,
      "vacancy_unlock",
      29_900,
      payment_status,
    )
---
          case payment_status {
            "paid" ->
              run_completed_side_effects(
                tx,
                config,
                event_id,
                session_id,
                payment_intent,
                amount_cents,
                amount_total_opt,
                consent_terms,
                vacancy_id_opt,
                sku_type_metadata_opt,
              )
            _ -> Ok(PendingPayment)
          }
detail: All processing/unpaid/missing-status fixtures (run_pending_completed_assertions) drive the gate with 'vacancy_unlock'; the shared gate also guards the VacancyExtension arm (gate runs before run_completed_side_effects SKU routing), but no non-paid extension fixture exists, so a SKU-specific gate regression would pass unnoticed.
recommended_fix: Add one processing/unpaid fixture seeding a 'vacancy_extension' payment row that asserts the row stays pending, closes_at is unchanged, and no audit fires on the PendingPayment path.

title: New checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded arm only exercised with payment_status='paid' — its PendingPayment branch is untested directly
evidence:
build_event_body_full(
      settle_event_id,
      "checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded",
      session_id,
      vacancy_id,
      "vacancy_unlock",
      29_900,
      "paid",
    )
---
            "checkout.session.completed"
            | "checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded" ->
              handle_checkout_completed(
                config,
                event_type,
                event_id,
                session_id,
                option.unwrap(payment_status, ""),
detail: The settle test drives the new arm only with 'paid'. The arm's non-paid branch (case payment_status in handle_checkout_completed:412-426) is shared with the completed arm and transitively covered, but no fixture drives async_payment_succeeded with processing/unpaid, so an arm-specific gate regression would go uncaught.
recommended_fix: Drive async_payment_succeeded once with payment_status='processing', asserting the PendingPayment outcome (vacancy locked, row pending, event claimed, ack 200) mirrors the completed-arm fixtures.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
evidence:
is_paid |> should.equal(0)
  row_status |> should.equal("pending")
  count_processed_event(db, event_id) |> should.equal(1)
  audit_count |> should.equal(0)
  count_payment_notifications(db, vacancy_id) |> should.equal(0)
  analysis_count |> should.equal(0)
---
  is_paid |> should.equal(1)
  row_status |> should.equal("completed")
  count_audit_for_event(db, settle_event_id) |> should.equal(1)
  count_payment_notifications(db, vacancy_id) |> should.equal(1)
  analysis_count |> should.equal(1)
  // Phase 3: replay of the settle event short-circuits (idempotent).
  resp2.status |> should.equal(200)
  count_processed_event(db, settle_event_id) |> should.equal(1)
detail: P0 100%: processing/unpaid/missing fixtures assert locked+pending and fail if the gate is removed; settle test drives unlock+completed+audit+notification+burst (real ai_analysis row)+replay end-to-end, unstubbed; card-only tripwire pinned; tag bump consumed in checkout_idempotency_key. P1 100%, overall >=80%. Only P3 secondary-axis gaps.
recommended_fix: Add the two P3 boundary fixtures (extension-SKU non-paid, async-arm non-paid) to close the fixture-matrix gaps; no P0/P1 work required for the gate to remain PASS.
